framePacingPolicy.scope: Current desktop playability floor; preserve p95/p99, individual pause, hitch frequency, coverage, memory and resource criteria. Historical FPS snapshots remain references, not current acceptance.
framePacingPolicy.ownerPriority: Keep the accepted playable frame rate and fix visible jitter/stalling; do not reduce building coverage to chase a historical FPS value.
